name: Finset
sum_fiberwise'
result.signature:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] [inst_2 : Fintype κ]
  (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → κ) (f : κ → M), ∑ j, ∑ i ∈ s with g i = j, f j = ∑ i ∈ s, f (g i)
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] [inst_2 : Fintype κ]
  (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → κ) (f : κ → M), ∑ j, ∑ i ∈ s with g i = j, f j = ∑ i ∈ s, f (g i)
result.informal_description: For any finite set $s$ of type $\iota$, function $g : \iota \to \kappa$, and function $f : \kappa \to M$ where $M$ is an additive commutative monoid, the sum over all $j \in \kappa$ of the sum of $f(j)$ over elements $i \in s$ satisfying $g(i) = j$ equals the sum over all $i \in s$ of $f(g(i))$. Formally, $\sum_{j} \sum_{\substack{i \in s \\ g(i) = j}} f(j) = \sum_{i \in s} f(g(i))$.

name: Finset
sum_fiberwise
result.signature:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] [inst_2 : Fintype κ]
  (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → κ) (f : ι → M), ∑ j, ∑ i ∈ s with g i = j, f i = ∑ i ∈ s, f i
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] [inst_2 : Fintype κ]
  (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → κ) (f : ι → M), ∑ j, ∑ i ∈ s with g i = j, f i = ∑ i ∈ s, f i
result.informal_name: Fiberwise Sum Decomposition in Additive Commutative Monoids
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of type $\iota$, function $ g : \iota \to \kappa $ to a finite type $\kappa$ with decidable equality, and function $ f : \iota \to M $ into an additive commutative monoid $ M $, the sum of $ f(i) $ over all $ i \in s $ equals the sum over each fiber $ g^{-1}(j) $ of the sum of $ f(i) $ restricted to that fiber. Symbolically: $\sum_{i \in s} f(i) = \sum_{j \in \kappa} \sum_{\substack{i \in s \\ g(i) = j}} f(i)$.

result.type:
∀ {M : Type u_4} {κ : Type u_6} {ι : Type u_7} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq κ] (g : ι → κ) (f : ι → M), ∑ j, ∑ i, f ↑i = ∑ i, f i
result.informal_description: For any finite types $\iota$ and $\kappa$, any additive commutative monoid $M$, any function $g : \iota \to \kappa$, and any function $f : \iota \to M$, the total sum $\sum_{i \in \iota} f(i)$ is equal to the sum over all $j \in \kappa$ of the sum of $f(i)$ over the fiber $g^{-1}(j)$, i.e., $\sum_{i \in \iota} f(i) = \sum_{j \in \kappa} \sum_{i \in g^{-1}(j)} f(i)$.

name: Finset
sum_set_coe

  ∑ i, f ↑i = ∑ i ∈ s.toFinset, f i
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f : ι → M} (s : Set ι) [inst_1 : Fintype ↑s],
  ∑ i, f ↑i = ∑ i ∈ s.toFinset, f i
result.informal_name: Sum over Set Equals Sum over Finset
result.informal_description: For any additive commutative monoid $ M $, type $ \iota $, function $ f : \iota \to M $, and finite set $ s \subseteq \iota $, the sum of $ f(i) $ over all $ i \in s $ is equal to the sum of $ f(i) $ over the Finset representation of $ s $. Formally, $ \sum_{i \in s} f(i) = \sum_{i \in s.\text{toFinset}} f(i) $.
